title: Early category information versus visual and ocular cues
scientific_question: At the frozen 80–160 ms summary window, do neural-plus-visual/ocular observations predict27 overlapping object-category labels better than an independently computed nuisance model on held person/session/concept groups?
primary_outputs: The27 binary concept-category memberships per source image; numerical evidence is out-of-fold probability loss and its prespecified contrasts, not a required positive semantic conclusion.

data_manifest.version: OpenNeuro2.0.1 (dataset DOI in current BIDS metadata)

example_asset.scope: Main run data only; CTF sidecars add space

recording_contract.neural: CTF MEG sensor recordings (.ds/.meg4) plus channel,head position and trigger metadata
recording_contract.labels: Actual events.tsv: onset,duration,trial_type,things_category_nr,value,sample; sample_attributes_P*.csv provides epoch metadata
recording_contract.time_alignment: Pinned loader replaces trigger sample positions with optical-sensor-corrected event sample column; filters0.1–40Hz,epochs−0.1to1.3s,downsamples200Hz.

recording_contract.evidence: BIDS dataset_description/participants/events and S3 recording manifest inspected; pinned preprocessing source accesses those fields

inputs: Full-core five feature arms VISUAL, OCULAR, NUISANCE, NEURAL and JOINT.
Visual103 fixed file-pixel features, ocular24 binned gaze/pupil means/fractions, neural1084 values from271 sensors × four20ms bins.
Five frozen windows PRE, EARLY_MINUS, EARLY, EARLY_PLUS, LATE; primary EARLY80–160ms.
Optional direct D condition uses train-only PCA8 serialized summaries and label-conditioned summary statistics, not native waveforms.
forbidden_inputs: Original source IDs, annotation tables, query labels and other queries.
Query-conditioned fitting/calibration/state updates or source metadata that resolves image category.
allowed_inputs.case_identity: Fresh opaque slot and query aliases created by views.py; source people BIGMEG1–4,12 sessions and five concept groups map privately to240 folds.
allowed_inputs.split: Query = held person AND held session ordinal AND held concept group; train excludes each of those three factors. Pool all five query concept folds within person/session before scoring. No cross-outer-case state.
allowed_inputs.coverage: Full88,992 experimental rows are queried once per selected mode/window/arm;108,192 recorded rows include repeat/catch exclusions. Four people ×12 sessions ×5 concept groups ×5 windows ×5 arms; exact authentic roster not yet qualified.

biological_unit: Four people with12 sessions each and shared concepts;240 outer folds and6,000 window/arm artifacts are dependent conditions.
case_definition: One crossed person/session/concept-group episode with row-local query predictions.

split.coverage: Full88,992 experimental rows are queried once per selected mode/window/arm;108,192 recorded rows include repeat/catch exclusions. Four people ×12 sessions ×5 concept groups ×5 windows ×5 arms; exact authentic roster not yet qualified.

reference.role: Official preprocessing and time-resolved decoding analyses; dependencies, payload QC and numerical results remain untested.

controls: 103 image features and ocular features are finite controls, not exhaustive visual/eye confound elimination.
Whole-run filtering/ocular processing invalidate a strict causal-window claim; jittered EARLY windows are diagnostics.
Keep27 independent Bernoulli labels rather than normalize to a simplex; prevalence-weighted loss reported separately.

direct_observation.boundary: Same serialized summaries for participant and DG/DC controls; separate E06 condition and whole selected-support seal.

tool_assisted.boundary: Exact same support and prospective resources as P; no query updates or cross-case state; full prequery policy frozen.

primary.name: E01/EARLY: fixed R1 nuisance balanced log loss minus candidate JOINT balanced log loss
primary.aggregation: Pool five concept folds per person/session, balance positive/negative class loss within each label, average27 labels,12 sessions then4 people.
primary.rationale: An independent nuisance baseline prevents rewarding a deliberately weakened candidate-only control; it remains a joint method/information contrast.

secondary: E02 same-input candidate gain against independent R1 JOINT.
E03 matched-family nuisance-to-joint effects; all five windows and control arms.
Balanced accuracy, unweighted log loss, exact0/1 and clipped counts; source loss floor1e-15 disclosed.
E06 direct-summary comparisons against both DG/DC same-summary controls; no shared primary with full-core.
Arithmetic report-claim consistency separately from unqualified reasoning review.

comparators.name: Independent R1 nuisance and joint
comparators.procedure: Implemented fixed ridge-LDA comparator; nuisance and joint are independently computed, not candidate-produced denominators.

comparators.name: R0/R1/R2 family augmentation
comparators.inputs: Same train/query support for nuisance and joint
comparators.procedure: Implemented fixed-family comparisons test robustness to bounded estimator choice.

comparators.name: DG diagonal Gaussian and DC nearest centroid
comparators.inputs: Exactly the serialized train-only PCA8 direct summaries
comparators.procedure: Implemented source controls for D-only E06; never compare D as equal-input full-core.

nuisance_controls: 103 image features and ocular features are finite controls, not exhaustive visual/eye confound elimination.
Whole-run filtering/ocular processing invalidate a strict causal-window claim; jittered EARLY windows are diagnostics.
Keep27 independent Bernoulli labels rather than normalize to a simplex; prevalence-weighted loss reported separately.
evaluation.uncertainty: Show all four person effects and descriptive t3 intervals only; shared stimuli/folds do not yield calibrated population intervals or a formal selected null test.
evaluation.failure_policy: Require complete selected campaign and all independent banks before target-last scoring. Missing label/class support invalidates the metric; no deleting difficult sessions. D-only campaigns have E01–E05 not selected, not failed full-core outputs.
